title: Oxva Slim Stick Cola Ice Prefilled Vape Pods 20mg - 2PK
description: These Cola Ice Prefilled Pods for the Oxva Slim Stick Prefilled Pod Kit offer a familiar soda-inspired flavour with a refreshing twist. Each pod comes preloaded with 2ml of 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid, providing up to 600 puffs depending on personal use. The flavour delivers the unmistakable taste of classic Cola, complete with its sweet, tangy soda character, brightened by a streak of cooling Ice on the exhale. The result is a vape that feels both nostalgic and refreshing, ideal for fans of fizzy drink flavours. Built-in coils ensure a consistent vape experience throughout, while the sealed pod format makes replacements quick and simple. Each pack contains two pods designed for a smooth mouth-to-lung draw, ready to slot into the Slim Stick kit without any maintenance required.
